title.narrative: Provision of Integrated and Innovative Approach assistance to POCs through Area based Protection Response in Jere, Konduga and MMC LGAs

description.narrative: ltpgtThe three key component of this project are:lt/pgtltpgt1. This project is addressing Envelope 1 covering thematic area in CCCM, Shelter/NFI, and Protection.ltbrgt2. The project will contribute to Protection of Girls and Vulnerable Women in the following areas, prioritizes unique protection needs of women and girls, enhancing living conditions and safety in displacement settings., Implements innovative protection strategies tailored to address vulnerabilities faced by women and girls, focusing on gender-specific risks, Creates women and girls committees, actively involving them in decision-making processes for a participatory approach to safety, dignity, and empowerment etc.ltbrgt3. In Innovations the project will focus on Leverages technology for community engagement to amplify gender-sensitive initiatives, ensuring safety, dignity, and empowerment of women and girls, Incorporates advanced distribution methods for MHM/Dignity Kits (the method will ensures equal access to tailored hygiene kits for women and girls, prioritizing safety, dignity, gender sensitivity, age appropriateness, and cultural respect to support well-being.), tailored to meet unique hygiene and dignity needs of women and girls in challenging circumstances, Creates culturally rich green spaces and child-friendly areas for community well-being, fostering social practices, and environmental rehabilitation.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe project summarylt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThis project, falling under Envelope 1 of NHF 2023 standard allocation 1, emphasizes addressing immediate needs of displaced populations with a focus on Protection and gender-sensitive interventions. It aims to enhance camp facilities, prioritizing the safety and dignity of women and girls through improved infrastructure and services. Special attention is given to developing innovative protection strategies tailored to the vulnerabilities faced by women and girls in displacement settings. Community-based protection mechanisms target gender-specific risks, ensuring a safe environment that upholds their dignity and rights.ltbrgtThe project employs technology and community engagement to combat GBV and enhance the impact of gender-sensitive initiatives. It systematically assesses intervention implications, conducting gender analyses and ensuring women's active participation in decision-making processes.ltbrgtIn Non-Food Items (NFIs), the project caters to the specific needs of women and girls, distributing Dignity Kits and Menstrual Hygiene Kits, recognizing their unique hygiene requirements in challenging circumstances.ltbrgtThe area-based approach in MMC, Jere, and Konduga camps is crucial, addressing challenges faced by women and girls in each designated area. Disability considerations are mainstreamed, addressing concerns and access barriers faced by women and girls with disabilities.ltbrgtImplementation involves various activities like CCCM, Innovative Area-based Site Facilitation, Community Leadership Strengthening, Referral Systems, and design and implement community-centered green gardens/yards of culturally rich green spaces and child-friendly areas for community well-being, fostering social practices and environmental rehabilitation will be considered. Creative distribution methods for NFIs cater specifically to women and girls. Community Engagement uses technology for a participatory approach, focusing on safety, dignity, and empowerment.ltbrgtProtection Strategies involve Community-Based Protection Mechanisms for safety. Innovative Technology for Empowerment amplifies gender-sensitive initiatives, fostering empowerment among women and girls. Continuous Adaptation includes rapid response plans, prioritizing the most vulnerable, especially women and girls.ltbrgtltbrgtSHO will oversees activities in Jere and Konduga, including reception centers, camps, and host communities, integrating CCCM and Shelter/NFI. Care Aid Support Initiative manages MMC activities, covering CCCM and NFI with SHO support. Protection is incorporated across all components.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtlt/pgt
